The '''Purrgil King''' was a large [[Gender|male]] [[purrgil]] who led a group of purrgil. He was [[Color|multicolored]] showing that he was the leader as well as bigger than the other purrgil in the group. He befriended [[Ezra Bridger]] and saved his life.<ref name="The Call Trivia" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Purrgil King appeared in the [[The Call|fifteenth episode]] of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]] of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. The episode released on [[February 10]], [[2016]],<ref name="Schedule">{{WebCite|url=http://affiliate.zap2it.com/tv/star-wars-rebels/EP018796240044?aid=dxd|text=Star Wars Rebels: The Call|work=Disney XD Official Schedule|archivedate=20161224185929}}</ref> and was directed by [[Mel Zwyer]].<ref name="The Call">{{Rebels|The Call}}</ref>
